title: How to Make AI-Generated UI Look Expensive (7 Fixes)
description:
AI-generated UI has a very specific look, and it comes down to the same seven things. In this video, I go through each one, show what it looks like when it's missing, and then fix an AI-generated page live with Claude using the exact prompts for each step.

You'll also see real examples from Linear, Stripe, Notion and Apple Maps, plus a 7-question checklist you can run on your own UI.
